keyVerseDR: "Many sins are forgiven her, because she hath loved much." (Lk 7:47)

level1.title: Big Love, Big Forgiveness
level1.story: A woman came to Jesus crying. She washed His feet with her tears and anointed them with oil. Jesus said, "Your sins are forgiven. Go in peace."
level1.heartIntro: Draw inside the heart, then color it!
questions: What did the woman do for Jesus?
How can you say thank You to Jesus?
level1.prayer: Jesus, thank You for forgiving me. Amen.

activity.title: Go in peace
activity.intro: Make a sign of peace card for someone.

level2.title: The Forgiven Woman
level2.story: A Pharisee named Simon invited Jesus to dinner. A woman who was a sinner came with an alabaster box of ointment. She stood at His feet weeping, washed His feet with her tears, wiped them with her hair, and anointed them. Jesus told Simon a parable of two debtors, and said, "Many sins are forgiven her, because she hath loved much." To the woman He said, "Thy faith hath made thee safe, go in peace."
level2.keyLine: Many sins are forgiven her, because she hath loved much.
level2.heartIntro: Write 3 ways you can do each, then color the border!
questions: How are forgiveness and love connected?
Why did Simon miss the point?
level2.prayer: Jesus, I love You for forgiving me. Amen.

activity.title: Vestment colors
activity.intro: The priest wears colors that mean something. Match each color.
